_intent: PP-M02 (critic_oscillation) — round 1 打回后任何合理修改都会引入新码, 第 2 轮立即升级, critic 调用计数恰好 2, 不进第 3 轮。本 fixture 把两条互斥闸显式写到节点结构里, 让 critic 静态判词暴露不可解性。

_gates.A_visual_oracle_required: 任何节点声明 output_path 指向 image/png OR contentType='image/png' 视为视觉产出; 视觉产出必须挂 oracle (oracleKind ∈ {cheap, render, judge, self_built}); 挂 none 即 PP-O01。
_gates.B_none_oracle_must_not_be_visual: oracleKind:'none' 的节点不得声明视觉产出字段 (output_path / contentType / attach_media), 否则语义等于 '让 LLM 看图' — 与 none 的零验证语义互斥。
_gates.mutex_proof: A 要求 visual 节点必有 oracle; B 要求 none 节点必非 visual。任一节点同时命中 '视觉产出字段' + 'oracleKind:none' 即同时违 A 与 B — 改 oracleKind 解 A → 触发 B 在另一节点复发; 改 output_path 解 B → 触发 A 在原节点复发; 两边一起改 → schema 形状漂移触发 PP-I02。

name: mutually-exclusive-gates
description: Fixture 故意构造 (visual_render 节点: oracleKind='none' AND output_path 指向 image/png) 同时命中 PP-O01; 同一 fixture 同时声明第二个节点 (visual_review) 受 manifest.checks 约束要求 '视觉产出必须挂 judge oracle', 任何一处修改必然破坏另一处。期望: critic round 1 = [PP-O01, ...], round 2 = 引入新码 → 立即 PP-M02 escalate, 总 calls=2, escalated=true。

skills.description: Soft contract: declares that any visual-output node MUST carry a judge oracle (red_line), and any node carrying oracleKind:'none' MUST NOT be a visual producer. These two rules are mutually exclusive at single-node granularity.

visual_render.goal: Render an image/png artifact from the upstream structured payload.
visual_render.whyNoFanout: Single visual producer; no peer of the same kind to parallelize with.
visual_render._mutex_marker_B: Per skill 'skill-visual-guard' red_line 'none_oracle_excludes_visual_output', this node simultaneously violates red_line. Fix attempts: (1) flip oracleKind to 'judge' → violates A's complement in visual_review below; (2) drop output_path → violates the plan-level outputs declaration. Either fix introduces a NEW critic code in round 2 → oscillation.

visual_review.goal: Judge the visual artifact against acceptance rubric; must emit a structured verdict.
visual_review.whyNoFanout: Terminal judge over a single visual artifact; no peer to fan with.
visual_review._mutex_marker_C: This node is the 'fix target' for PP-O01 on visual_render — but flipping visual_render's oracleKind to 'judge' creates a SECOND judge (visual_review) over the SAME artifact with the SAME red_line set → tool-pool escalation + duplicate-judge semantics triggers PP-S02 (allowed_tools_exceeded: read) when skill's allowed_tools is tightened to ⊆ natural pool. Conversely removing visual_review does not fix the underlying contradiction — it just hides it.
